newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt says Opp'n obstructs migration programme.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt says Opp'n obstructs migration programme.

text.p: Australian Immigration Minister Philip Ruddock said on Thursday the Senate had prevented the government from properly managing the migration programme.

"The decision by non-government senators to disallow migration regulations means that for the first time in history, an elected government will not be allowed to do its job of managing the migration programme," Ruddock said in a statement.
The Liberal-National government said in July it would cut the migrant intake by 10.8 percent to 74,000 for fiscal 1996/97.
The government said it would select migrants with better language skills, better work skills, and greater ability to contribute quickly to national wealth.
The government does not have a majority in the upper house, the Senate, which can disallow regulations.
